div.l: A morowe when the day gan sprynge
Vppe ros oure oste and was alle oure cokke
And gadred vs alle in a flocke
And forth we rode litle more than apaas
Vnto the watrynge of seynt thomas
And there oure ost gan his hors areste
And seyde herkeneth lordynges yf ye lyste
Ye wote oure forewarde and I you recorde
Yf evesonge and morowe son accorde .
Lett se nowe who shalle telle the first tale
As evir mote I drynke wyne or Ale
Who that wolle be rebel to my iugement
Shalle pay for alle that is be wey spent
NOwe drawe cutt or that ye ferthir twynne
Whiche shalle the first tale begynne
Sir knyght quoth he maister and my lorde
Draweth cutt for that is myn accorde
Cometh hedir quoth he my lady pryores
And ye sir Clerke let be youre shamfastnes
And stody not ley on honde euery man
Anone to withdrawe eủery wight began
And shortly to telle as hit was
Were it be aventure fortune or caas
The soth is this the cutt felle on the knyght
Of whiche fulle blythe and glad is euery wight
And telle must he as hit was reason
Be forward and by composicion
As ye haue herde whate nedeth wordes mo
And whan this good mān sawe that it was so
As he that was wise and obedyent
To kepe his forwarde by his fre assent
He seyde sithens I shalle be gyn the gam
